title: cenostigma pinnatum var. oblongifolium
intro: Cenostigma pinnatum var. oblongifolium, commonly known as Brazilian hawthorn, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The leaves and fruits of this plant have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Cenostigma pinnatum var. oblongifolium include vasorelaxation and antioxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
